label: PF Backlog 229
title: EPIC: pipeline E2E reliability - events, readiness checklist, model registry/capability gate, lock/status fixes
body:
E2E pipeline reliability, model registry and agent readiness. Phases:

P0 (implementing): 1) time-budget stop must NOT report completion; 2) model-fit probe must not template-mask failures (allow_template=False); 3) lock reclaim by dead PID + force-unlock; 4) emit agent/stage lifecycle events (agent_started/completed/failed/blocked); 5) per-agent PRE-execution readiness checklist with report + events + API; 6) cross-provider fallback including OpenCode Zen (mimo-v2.6-flash-free).

P1: 7) refresh model registry on run start (OpenRouter + Zen + opencode-go + anthropic/openai/gemini) with last_refreshed stamp + retired flag; 8) per-agent capability contract (needs_tools / needs_reasoning / min_context / min_output); 9) Model Capability Gate validating every configured tier and RECOMMENDING (user can change) - block run if essential agent has no viable model; 10) prompt-cache invalidation when instruction builders change; 11) remove duplicate product-owner invocation (stage 0b vs ideation partner).

P2: 12) idea-based dynamic run plan (skip stages not needed, user-editable); 13) per-agent budget/wall time (not per-call) with re-check then clean timeout; 14) status accuracy via single writer; 15) provider rate budgeting/pacing.

Acceptance: a run either finishes or stops with an accurate reason; no silent templates/false-green; agents blocked loudly when inputs/model missing; dashboard shows readiness + compliance and raises events/alarms; a crash never leaves a blocking lock.
